meta.note: 推荐引擎的候选组合。规则：先满足 VRAM/RAM/磁盘约束，再按 时间→质量→依赖复杂度 打分。

flags_reference.--fast-disk: 权重放页缓存（可回收），RAM 峰值 45.4→12.6GiB；RAM 不足时首选
flags_reference.--cache-none: 节点输出不缓存；不解决权重驻留
flags_reference.--lowvram: 低显存模式（旧路径）；新版本优先 DynamicVRAM 自动处理
flags_reference.--disable-mmap: Windows 下 >20GB safetensors 用 mmap 会崩，ComfyUI>=0.31 建议加
flags_reference.--use-sage-attention: 核心 Sage 注意力；sm_120 长序列有噪声风险，见 conflicts.json

sets.name: 入门档（8-10GB 显存）
sets.expected_en: 480-540p 5s; 4-8 steps; 3-10 min per clip; start at 736x416
sets.notes: 16GB 内存下必须配合 ≥48GB 页文件；15s 片段基本不可用
sets.notes_en: With 16GB RAM a ≥48GB pagefile is mandatory; 15s clips are basically unusable

sets.name: 均衡档（12-16GB 显存）
sets.notes: 官方推荐的最小组合（42.5GB）；32GB 内存时 TE+DiT 无法同时常驻，建议 --fast-disk
sets.notes_en: Official minimum recommended combination (42.5GB); with 32GB RAM the TE+DiT cannot both stay resident, use --fast-disk

sets.name: 质量档（24GB 显存）
sets.notes: 24GB 基本无需逐层卸载；INT8 与 bf16 画质差距经实测约 0.9% 量化误差
sets.notes_en: 24GB needs almost no layer-by-layer offloading; measured INT8 vs bf16 quality gap is about 0.9% quantization error

sets.name: Blackwell 专用（50 系 16GB+）
sets.notes: NVFP4 需 sm_120；SLA / VSA 稀疏注意力可再提速（长片 1.4-1.75×，见第 2 步注意力选项）
sets.notes_en: NVFP4 requires sm_120; SLA / VSA sparse attention can speed things up further (1.4-1.75x on long clips, see the attention options in step 2)

sets.name: 旗舰档（32GB+ 显存）
sets.expected: 1344x768 全时长 5-15s；4-8 步；3s 片段端到端约 80s（本机 5090 实测）
sets.expected_en: 1344x768 full length 5-15s; 4-8 steps; ~80s end-to-end for a 3s clip (measured on our 5090)

sets.name: 研究档（96GB+ / 多卡）
sets.expected: 研究/训练用途；消费级不推荐
sets.expected_en: For research/training; not recommended for consumer use
sets.notes: 全精度组合 123.6GB；生产/多卡服务见 vLLM 等部署路径
sets.notes_en: Full-precision combination is 123.6GB; for production/multi-GPU serving see deployment paths such as vLLM
